description:
Design: `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, section "Links across boards". Stored refs are `boardID:cardID`. `[linked_boards]` in project config (`project/3`) records the board's name and its repo's remote URL with any credentials removed, used only for the "isn't on this machine" message. `kan show` lists reverse links from other boards.

After a_2naKGoYNg and a_2naKEczaZ.
title: Link cards across boards and record where linked boards live
